name: Microsoft To Do
description: Microsoft To Do is a personal task management product for Microsoft accounts and Microsoft 365. People use it to organize task lists, track priorities and dates, set reminders, and manage everyday work across devices.
agentUseSummary: Connect Microsoft To Do through Relay-owned Microsoft OAuth for personal or work accounts, then let agents inspect bounded task-list and privacy-scrubbed task metadata through four fixed Graph wrappers. Relay excludes bodies, categories, checklists, linked resources, attachments, shared-task expansion, collaborator identities, writes, application or other-user access, delta, extensions, exports, pagination, beta APIs, and raw Graph access.

capabilities.label: Read task lists
capabilities.description: Review bounded task-list metadata for the signed-in Microsoft account.

capabilities.label: Read task metadata
capabilities.description: Review bounded, privacy-scrubbed tasks in one explicit task list.

allowed.label: List task lists
allowed.description: List at most twenty-five bounded task lists for the signed-in Microsoft account.

allowed.label: Read task-list metadata
allowed.description: Read bounded metadata for one explicit prior-result Microsoft To Do task list.

allowed.label: List tasks
allowed.description: List at most twenty-five privacy-scrubbed tasks from one explicit prior-result task list.

allowed.label: Read task metadata
allowed.description: Read privacy-scrubbed metadata for one explicit prior-result task without body or related content.

blocked.label: Read task bodies or related content
blocked.description: Bodies, categories, checklist items, linked resources, attachments, source links, and related content are outside V1.

blocked.label: Expand shared tasks or collaborators
blocked.description: Shared-task expansion, collaborator identities, people, groups, and directory access are outside V1.

blocked.label: Change To Do resources
blocked.description: Create, update, complete, move, reorder, and delete operations are outside V1.

blocked.label: Use broad or raw access
blocked.description: Application permissions, other-user access, delta, extensions, exports, automatic pagination, beta APIs, and raw Graph access are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Four bounded delegated reads run automatically; private content, shared expansion, writes, application access, delta, pagination, beta, and raw Graph remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same four delegated reads run without Relay per-action approval; exact scope, signed-in-user authority, limits, audit, redaction, and Microsoft controls still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts four bounded Microsoft To Do read wrappers and attaches encrypted Microsoft tokens only on Railway.
Relay mounts four bounded Microsoft To Do read wrappers and attaches encrypted Microsoft tokens only on Railway.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay still needs its Entra application registration for personal and organizational accounts, delegated Tasks.Read configuration, exact Railway callback, staging credentials, personal and work test accounts, and Microsoft acceptance. Those provider-console and live-consent actions are outside this worker task.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task, configure the Relay-owned Entra application and exact callback, store its credentials on Railway staging, then verify personal- and work-account consent, exact scope, PKCE/state, refresh rotation, signed-in-user binding, all four reads, privacy exclusions, throttling, revocation, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Microsoft Graph delegated authorization uses the v2 authorization-code flow, supports PKCE, and uses offline_access when a refresh token is required.
Delegated Tasks.Read permits reading the signed-in user's tasks and is available to personal and organizational Microsoft accounts.
GET /me/todo/lists lists the signed-in user's task lists with least-privileged delegated Tasks.Read.
Microsoft Graph provides an exact signed-in-user task-list metadata read under delegated Tasks.Read.
Microsoft Graph provides a fixed task-list tasks endpoint under delegated Tasks.Read.
Microsoft Graph provides an exact task read for the signed-in user under delegated Tasks.Read.
